Cell.Data: DVI V2 test cases: what changed in the spec since 22 September
We checked the Digital Inspection V2 test cases against every current source on 14 October 2026, and we would like to share what has changed, in case it helps.
Our cases were written against the spec as it was on 22 September. The spec has changed a number of times since, up to version 43 on 13 October. Some cases still follow the earlier wording.
The DVI V2 team sync of 12 October says "QA on the feature squad owns writing and updating test cases", so these updates are yours to make. We have not edited any case.
Some of these cases are automated. Where the behaviour changed, the automation may still check the old behaviour.

One row per case and spec rule: what the spec said before, what it says now, when the spec changed it (from the spec's own change log), and what to do. "Please check" rows are cases that word the rule in their own way.
Decisions made in Jira after the spec text was written. The latest decision wins, so the case should follow it.
New rules, or later decisions, that no case covers yet.
